name: City Memory API
description: Read-only reference data for all 565 Belgian municipalities: official names in Dutch, French and German, NIS codes, province and region, WGS84 centroid, bounding box, area and boundary geometry.
cors: Every endpoint is public, unauthenticated and sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
